title: Spicy Vietnamese Pork Bun
description: A fusion twist on the classic German sausage, this spicy Vietnamese pork bun is a flavorful and refreshing take on traditional German cuisine.

ingredients.name: vietnamese
ingredients.notes: Fish sauce, lime juice, and chili flakes for marinade

instructions: 1. In a large mixing bowl, combine ground pork, fish sauce, lime juice, and chili flakes. Mix well until all ingredients are fully incorporated.
2. Divide the pork mixture into 4 equal parts and shape each part into a ball. Flatten each ball slightly into a patty.
3. Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat and add pork fat for browning. Once hot, add the patties and cook for 3-4 minutes on each side, until browned and cooked through.
4. Meanwhile, toast the Vietnamese buns by grilling them over an open flame or by baking them in the oven for a few minutes.
5. Assemble the buns by placing a cooked patty on each bun, followed by a few slices of fresh chili and a drizzle of sweet chili sauce.
